# Bariq Gifts

Official site: https://bariqgifts.com/

Bariq Gifts, also known as Bariq, Bariq Gifts UAE, and بريق للهدايا, is a UAE-focused custom gifts and event products website.

## Verified Business Information

- Official Arabic brand name: بريق للهدايا.
- Phone and WhatsApp: +971554423151.
- Email: bariq.gifts@gmail.com.
- Location: Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates.
- Service area: all areas of the United Arab Emirates.
- Delivery is available within the UAE, and customer visits are available.
- Working hours: 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM, Saturday to Thursday. Friday is closed.
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/bariq.gifts/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/bariq.gifts

## What Bariq Offers

- Personalized gifts and occasion giveaways.
- Corporate gift options and promotional products where customization is available.
- Event and occasion products such as stands, tables, display pieces, gift boxes, trays, stickers, and related items.
- Occasion-focused categories including newborn, graduation, Ramadan, National Day, Haq Al-Laila, Eid, Mother's Day, and Hajj.
- Material-focused categories including acrylic, forex, wood, leather, paper, and stickers.
- Design and production of custom requests based on the customer's requirements.
- Factory production in Ras Al Khaimah for custom gift orders and event products.

## Ordering Process

Customers can place orders through the website/store or official social channels. Bariq confirms order details and proof/design details with the customer before production where customization is involved.

Delivery to Gulf countries is planned soon, but current public service information should be treated as UAE-focused unless the live website states otherwise.
